study type: Subgroup analysis of 9 randomised controlled trials
exposure: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) prophylaxis during pregnancy
LMWH prophylaxis vs no LMWH prophylaxis
cohort: 512 women with prior placenta-mediated pregnancy complications (pre-eclampsia, late pregnancy loss, placental abruption or intrauterine growth restriction)
finding: There was no difference in the risk of caesarean delivery between women with labor induction and spontaneous labor.
